Kavya Banerjee | kavya.banerjee24@example.com | +91 9582678219
Koramangala, Bengaluru, India

Professional Summary
Azure-focused cloud engineer with a strong track record delivering infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments for enterprise applications. Experienced in designing and implementing Azure environments, Terraform-driven IaC, PowerShell automation, and Kubernetes operations. Open to relocating to Delhi NCR. Notice period: 90 days.

Technical Skills
Microsoft Azure, Terraform, k8s, PowerShell, Jira, Linux

Work Experience

Azure DevOps Engineer, NimbusSoft (Nov 2023 - Present)
- Implemented Terraform modules to provision Azure resource groups, VNets and AKS clusters, reducing environment provisioning time by 60% while following Microsoft Azure best practices.
- Automated CI/CD pipelines for containerized microservices using Azure DevOps, integrating k8s manifests and Helm charts to enable zero-downtime deployments across staging and production.
- Created PowerShell scripts to manage role assignments and automate routine Azure maintenance tasks; tracked work and incidents using Jira.
- Maintained Linux-based build agents and troubleshooting k8s node issues to improve cluster stability and reduce pod restarts.

Cloud Engineer, Accenture (Apr 2022 - Oct 2023)
- Led Terraform adoption for multiple projects, authoring reusable modules for Azure compute, storage and networking and enforcing state management to prevent drift.
- Coordinated k8s cluster upgrades and implemented GitOps workflows for deployment promotion; reduced rollback incidents by implementing health checks.
- Developed PowerShell automation for operational runbooks and scheduled tasks across Windows and Linux hosts; managed ticketing and sprint tasks in Jira.
- Supported Linux application containers and assisted in capacity planning for clusters to meet client SLAs.

Cloud Engineer, HCLTech (Mar 2021 - Mar 2022)
- Provisioned and configured Azure resources for client workloads, ensuring secure networking and subscription governance in Microsoft Azure.
- Wrote PowerShell automation for resource tagging, cost reporting and scheduled maintenance, improving tracking and reducing manual effort.
- Collaborated on container adoption initiatives, validating k8s deployment patterns and assisting in CI integrations.
- Performed Linux system administration for cloud-hosted components and logged work in Jira to maintain change history.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
